items.title_cn: D-二聚体/淋巴细胞比值与急性胰腺炎严重程度的相关性：一项横断面研究
items.title_en: Association of D-dimer/Lymphocyte ratio with severity in acute pancreatitis: a cross-sectional study
items.abstract_cn: D-二聚体/淋巴细胞比值（DLR）反映凝血激活和免疫状态，但其与急性胰腺炎（AP）严重程度的关系尚不明确。本研究旨在探讨DLR与AP严重程度之间的关联。本横断面研究纳入2024年2月至2025年4月期间在中国镇江江苏大学附属人民医院消化内科收治的285例成人AP患者。根据计算机断层扫描严重程度指数将疾病严重程度分为轻症急性胰腺炎（MAP）或中重症/重症急性胰腺炎（MSAP/SAP）。DLR计算为D-二聚体除以淋巴细胞计数，并经对数转换后记为LogDLR。采用Logistic回归和限制性立方样条（RCS）分析评估LogDLR与MSAP/SAP之间的关联。受试者工作特征（ROC）分析比较了LogDLR、NLR、PLR和CLR的判别性能；使用最大约登指数确定最佳截断值。在285例患者中，202例被归类为MAP，83例为MSAP/SAP。随着LogDLR升高，年龄、C反应蛋白、D-二聚体和住院时间呈上升趋势，而淋巴细胞计数下降。单因素分析显示，LogDLR与AP严重程度呈正相关（OR = 2.81，95%CI：1.70–4.66，P < 0.001）。在校正性别、年龄、体质指数、高血压和糖尿病后，该关联仍具有显著性（OR = 3.33，95%CI：1.90–5.81，P < 0.001），进一步校正甘油三酯、总胆固醇和低密度脂蛋白胆固醇后仍显著（OR = 3.45，95%CI：1.95–6.07，P < 0.001）。与最低四分位数组相比，Q4组患者的MSAP/SAP风险仍显著升高（模型1：Q4：OR = 4.21，95%CI：1.94–9.12，P < 0.001；模型2：Q4：OR = 5.34，95%CI：2.31–12.35，P < 0.001；模型3：Q4：OR = 5.57，95%CI：2.36–13.15，P < 0.001；均P < 0.001）。RCS分析显示存在总体关联（P < 0.001），但无统计学显著的非线性（P = 0.065）。LogDLR对MSAP/SAP的判别能力最高，AUC为0.68（95%CI：0.61–0.75）。较高的DLR与MSAP/SAP风险增加独立相关。尽管其判别性能中等，但DLR作为一种易于获取的标志物，可补充现有的严重程度评估，用于AP患者的早期风险分层。
items.abstract_en: The D-dimer/lymphocyte ratio (DLR) reflects coagulation activation and immune status, but its association with the severity of acute pancreatitis (AP) remains unclear. This study aimed to investigate the relationship between DLR and AP severity. This cross-sectional study included 285 adult patients with AP admitted to the Department of Gastroenterology, Affiliated People’s Hospital of Jiangsu University, Zhenjiang, China, between February 2024 and April 2025. Disease severity was classified according to the computed tomography severity index as mild acute pancreatitis (MAP) or moderately severe/severe acute pancreatitis (MSAP/SAP). DLR was calculated as D-dimer divided by lymphocyte count and was log-transformed as LogDLR. Logistic regression and restricted cubic spline (RCS) analyses were used to assess the association between LogDLR and MSAP/SAP. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis compared the discriminatory performance of LogDLR, NLR, PLR, and CLR; Optimal cut-off values were determined using the maximum Youden index. Among the 285 patients, 202 were classified as MAP and 83 as MSAP/SAP. As LogDLR increased, age, C-reactive protein, D-dimer, and length of hospital stay showed increasing trends, whereas lymphocyte count decreased. Univariate analysis showed that LogDLR was positively associated with AP severity (OR = 2,81, 95%CI: 1.70–4.66, P < 0.001). This association remained significant after adjustment for sex, age, body mass index, hypertension, and diabetes (OR = 3.33, 95%CI: 1.90–5.81, P < 0.001), and further adjustment for, triglycerides, total cholesterol, and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (OR = 3.45, 95%CI: 1.95–6.07, P < 0.001). Compared with the lowest quartile, the risk of MSAP/SAP in patients classified within group Q4 was remained significantly elevated (model 1: Q4: OR = 4.21, 95% CI: 1.94–9.12, P < 0.001, model 2: Q4: OR = 5.34, 95% CI: 2.31–12.35, P < 0.001, model 3: Q4: OR = 5.57, 95% CI: 2.36–13.15, P < 0.001); all P < 0.001). The RCS analysis showed an overall association ( P < 0.001) without statistically significant nonlinearity ( P = 0.065). LogDLR showed the highest discriminatory ability for MSAP/SAP, with an AUC of 0.68 (95% CI: 0.61–0.75). Higher DLR was independently associated with greater odds of MSAP/SAP. Although its discriminatory performance was modest, DLR may complement established severity assessments as a readily available marker for early risk stratification in patients with AP.
items.summary_cn: Higher D-dimer/lymphocyte ratio (DLR) was independently associated with greater odds of moderately severe or severe acute pancreatitis (MSAP/SAP), with an AUC of 0.68, suggesting DLR may complement established severity assessments for early risk stratification.

items.title_cn: 高甘油三酯血症性急性胰腺炎新型动态亚表型的早期预测：一项多中心队列研究
items.title_en: Early prediction of novel dynamic subphenotypes in acute pancreatitis with hypertriglyceridemia: a multicenter cohort study
items.abstract_cn: 随着全球代谢性疾病负担的不断加重，高甘油三酯血症相关性急性胰腺炎（AP-HTG）的患病率显著升高。然而，初始甘油三酯升高水平与不良临床结局之间并无严格的相关性。因此，本研究旨在识别反映内在病理生理状态的新型动态亚表型，并构建早期预测模型。临床病理学数据来源于MIMIC-IV数据库（n=344，开发队列）、eICU-CRD数据库（n=173，外部验证队列）以及独立的本中心队列（n=319，实用性验证队列）。采用基于分组的多元轨迹模型（GBMTM）对7天白细胞和钙离子轨迹进行分析，以识别新型亚表型。在评估多种机器学习算法后，基于入院当日指标，利用Boruta、LASSO和逻辑回归建立了最优早期预测模型。共识别出四种新型动态亚表型，其中重度高炎症型（C3）和脂毒性低钙型（C4）亚表型携带持续性器官衰竭和多器官功能障碍综合征的显著独立风险。此外，构建了包含白细胞、钙离子、淋巴细胞、白蛋白、血小板和红细胞压积的早期逻辑回归预测模型。该模型在开发队列（0.924）和外部验证队列（0.933）中均取得了较高的宏平均AUC值。本中心队列的实用性验证进一步证实了该模型在有效识别高危亚表型方面的应用价值。为增强模型的可解释性和临床实用性，本研究应用了SHAP分析，并将模型部署为免费的网络计算器以及专门针对C4亚表型设计的列线图。本研究识别出四种新型AP-HTG动态亚表型，并基于入院当日指标构建了经多中心验证的早期预测模型，有助于早期风险分层和个体化临床决策。
items.abstract_en: Concomitant with the escalating global burden of metabolic disorders, acute pancreatitis with hypertriglyceridemia (AP-HTG) has become highly prevalent. However, the initial triglyceride elevation does not strictly correlate with adverse clinical outcomes. Therefore, we aimed to identify novel dynamic subphenotypes reflecting the intrinsic pathophysiological state and develop an early prediction model. Clinicopathological data were collected from MIMIC-IV ( n = 344, development), eICU-CRD ( n = 173, external validation), and an independent local cohort ( n = 319, pragmatic validation). Group-based multi-trajectory modeling (GBMTM) of 7-day white blood cell and calcium trajectories was utilized to identify novel subphenotypes. After evaluating multiple machine-learning algorithms, an optimal early prediction model was established using Boruta, LASSO, and logistic regression based on admission-day indicators. Four novel dynamic subphenotypes were identified, with the Severe-Hyperinflammatory (C3) and Lipotoxic-Hypocalcemic (C4) subphenotypes carrying substantially increased independent risks for persistent organ failure and multiple organ dysfunction syndrome. Furthermore, an early logistic regression prediction model comprising white blood cells, calcium, lymphocytes, albumin, platelets, and hematocrit was developed. This model achieved high macro-average AUCs in the development (0.924) and external validation (0.933) cohorts. Pragmatic validation in the local cohort further confirmed its utility in effectively identifying high-risk subphenotypes. To enhance interpretability and clinical utility, SHAP analysis was applied, and the model was deployed as a free web-based calculator and a nomogram specifically designed for the C4 subphenotype. This study identified four novel dynamic AP-HTG subphenotypes and developed a multicenter-validated early prediction model using admission-day indicators. It facilitates early risk stratification and individualized clinical decision-making.
items.summary_cn: 该研究通过GBMTM识别出四种急性胰腺炎伴高甘油三酯血症的新型动态亚表型，其中C3和C4亚型显著增加持续性器官衰竭和多器官功能障碍综合征风险，并基于入院指标构建了多中心验证的早期预测模型。

items.title_cn: 胰十二指肠切除术后急性胰腺炎与临床相关术后胰瘘的关联：一项回顾性队列研究
items.title_en: Association of postoperative acute pancreatitis with clinically relevant postoperative pancreatic fistula after pancreaticoduodenectomy: a retrospective cohort study
items.summary_cn: 该研究探讨了胰十二指肠切除术后急性胰腺炎与临床相关术后胰瘘的关联，属于胰腺外科并发症领域，与用户关注的胰腺炎诊治有较强相关性，但非直接针对内科或内镜治疗。

items.title_cn: 急性呼吸衰竭的急性胰腺炎患者预后模型
items.title_en: Prognostic model for acute pancreatitis patients with acute respiratory failure
items.abstract_cn: 急性呼吸衰竭（ARF）是急性胰腺炎（AP）患者中常见的并发症，并与不良临床结局相关。本研究旨在构建一个预测模型，用于预测合并ARF的AP患者的死亡风险。从重症监护医学信息集市-III（MIMIC-III）数据库中提取诊断为ARF的AP患者数据。采用单变量和多变量逻辑回归分析来识别危险因素并构建预测模型。通过受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线评估模型的预测性能。在纳入的合并ARF的AP患者中，30天死亡率为21.5%。单变量分析显示，年龄较大（p < 0.001）、慢性肝病（p = 0.007）、心率升高（p = 0.034）、红细胞分布宽度（RDW）较高（p = 0.018）以及血乳酸升高（p = 0.004）与死亡显著相关。多变量分析确认了四个独立的死亡预测因素：年龄较大（p < 0.001）、慢性肝病（p < 0.001）、RDW升高（p = 0.035）以及血乳酸升高（p = 0.002）。最终纳入这四个变量的逻辑回归模型显示出受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）为0.792。所构建的逻辑回归模型表现出良好的预测能力，可能有助于临床医生评估合并ARF的AP患者的30天死亡风险。
items.abstract_en: Acute respiratory failure (ARF) is a frequent complication in patients with acute pancreatitis (AP) and is associated with adverse clinical outcomes. This study aimed to develop a prognostic model for predicting mortality in AP patients complicated by ARF. Data from AP patients diagnosed with ARF were extracted from the Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care-III (MIMIC-III) database. Univariate and multivariate logistic regression analyses were employed to identify risk factors and construct a prognostic model. The predictive performance of the model was assessed using the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve. Among the included AP patients with ARF, the 30-day mortality rate was 21.5%. Univariate analysis revealed that older age (p < 0.001), chronic liver disease (p = 0.007), elevated heart rate (p = 0.034), higher red cell distribution width (RDW) (p = 0.018), and increased blood lactate (p = 0.004) were significantly associated with mortality. Multivariate analysis confirmed four independent predictors of mortality: older age (p < 0.001), chronic liver disease (p < 0.001), elevated RDW (p = 0.035), and increased blood lactate (p = 0.002). The final logistic regression model, which incorporated these four variables, demonstrated an area under the ROC curve (AUC) of 0.792. The developed logistic regression model shows good predictive ability and may assist clinicians in assessing the 30-day mortality risk for AP patients with ARF.
items.summary_cn: 该研究基于MIMIC-III数据库发现，年龄较大、慢性肝病、红细胞分布宽度升高和血乳酸升高是急性胰腺炎合并急性呼吸衰竭患者30天死亡的独立预测因素，所构建的预测模型AUC为0.792，具有良好的预测能力。

items.title_cn: 入院D-二聚体对急性胰腺炎的预后价值：回顾性队列研究中与疾病严重程度及临床结局的关联
items.title_en: Prognostic value of admission D-dimer in acute pancreatitis: association with disease severity and clinical outcomes in a retrospective cohort study
items.abstract_cn: 急性胰腺炎（AP）的早期风险分层对于改善患者预后和指导及时临床管理至关重要。D-二聚体已成为反映凝血和纤溶系统激活的潜在生物标志物，可能有助于急性胰腺炎患者的早期风险分层。然而，其预后价值在不同人群中尚未得到充分验证。本回顾性队列研究纳入200例于2023年3月至2024年3月在某三级医院确诊为急性胰腺炎的成年患者。疾病严重程度采用修订版亚特兰大分类进行分级。入院血清D-二聚体在就诊后6小时内检测。分析入院D-二聚体水平与临床严重程度、BISAP评分、Ranson评分、ICU入住、住院时间及院内死亡率之间的关系。统计学分析包括非参数检验、相关性分析、logistic回归和ROC曲线分析以评估预测效能。本研究连续纳入200例患者，平均年龄58.1±17.5岁，其中54%为男性。严重程度分布为：轻型68.5%，中重型17%，重型14.5%。总体死亡率为7%（n=14），56%（n=112）需要入住ICU。入院D-二聚体水平随疾病严重程度显著升高，中位数分别为1534 ng/mL（轻型）、1908.5 ng/mL（中重型）和2960 ng/mL（重型）。死亡患者的D-二聚体水平显著高于存活患者（3776.5 vs. 1663 ng/mL，p<0.001）。D-二聚体与BISAP评分（ρ=0.6068）、Ranson评分（ρ=0.3425）及住院时间呈显著正相关。ROC分析显示，D-二聚体对重型AP具有良好的判别能力（AUC=0.778；截断值2035 ng/mL），对死亡预测具有良好的判别效能（AUC=0.912；截断值2726 ng/mL，敏感性85.7%，特异性80.1%）。然而，其对ICU入住的预测效能有限（AUC=0.579）。多因素分析显示，入院D-二聚体水平每增加1 ng/mL与重型AP风险升高独立相关（OR=1.001，p<0.001）。入院D-二聚体是一种简单、快速的生物标志物，与急性胰腺炎的疾病严重程度和死亡率相关。虽然不应取代既有的评分系统，但可作为早期风险分层的有价值辅助工具，尤其有助于识别高危患者。需要前瞻性多中心研究以验证其临床实用性并确定标准化截断值。
items.abstract_en: Early risk stratification in acute pancreatitis (AP) is crucial for improving patient outcomes and guiding timely clinical management. D-dimer has emerged as a potential biomarker reflecting activation of coagulation and fibrinolysis and may assist in early risk stratification of patients with acute pancreatitis. However, its prognostic performance remains incompletely validated across different populations. This retrospective cohort study included 200 adult patients diagnosed with acute pancreatitis between March 2023 and March 2024 at a tertiary care hospital. Disease severity was classified using the Revised Atlanta Classification. Admission serum D-dimer was measured within the first six hours after hospital presentation. Admission D-dimer levels were analyzed in relation to clinical severity, BISAP and Ranson scores, ICU admission, length of hospital stay, and in-hospital mortality. Statistical analyses included non-parametric tests, correlation analysis, logistic regression, and ROC curve analysis to evaluate predictive performance. Two hundred consecutive patients, with a mean age of 58.1 ± 17.5 years and 54% male patients, were included in this study. Severity distribution showed 68.5% mild, 17% moderately severe, and 14.5% severe AP. Overall mortality was 7% ( n = 14), and 56% ( n = 112) required ICU admission. Admission D-dimer levels increased significantly with disease severity, with median values of 1534 ng/mL (mild), 1908.5 ng/mL (moderately severe), and 2960 ng/mL (severe). Non-survivors had markedly higher levels than survivors (3776.5 vs. 1663 ng/mL, p < 0.001). D-dimer showed significant positive correlations with BISAP (ρ = 0.6068), Ranson scores (ρ = 0.3425), and hospital length of stay. ROC analysis demonstrated good discriminatory ability for severe AP (AUC = 0.778; cutoff 2035 ng/mL) and good discriminatory performance for mortality prediction (AUC = 0.912; cutoff 2726 ng/mL, sensitivity 85.7%, specificity 80.1%). However, performance for predicting ICU admission was limited (AUC = 0.579). Multivariable analysis demonstrated that each 1-ng/mL increase in admission D-dimer level was independently associated with higher odds of severe AP (OR = 1.001, p < 0.001). Admission D-dimer is a simple and rapid biomarker associated with disease severity and mortality in acute pancreatitis. While it should not replace established scoring systems, it can serve as a valuable adjunct for early risk stratification, particularly for identifying high-risk patients. Prospective multicenter studies are needed to validate its clinical utility and define standardized cutoff values.
items.summary_cn: 入院时D-二聚体水平随急性胰腺炎严重程度增加而显著升高，且与BISAP、Ranson评分及住院时间正相关；对预测重症（AUC=0.778）和死亡（AUC=0.912）具有良好判别能力，但对ICU入住预测能力有限。

items.title_cn: 异基因间充质干细胞移植通过抑制NF-κB信号减轻大鼠重症急性胰腺炎相关肺损伤
items.title_en: Allogeneic Mesenchymal Stem Cell Transplantation Attenuates Severe Acute Pancreatitis Associated Lung Injury by Inhibiting NF κB Signaling in Rats
items.summary_cn: 该研究未提供摘要，无法总结核心发现。

items.title_cn: 磁共振胰胆管成像、超声内镜、内镜逆行胰胆管造影及CT在胆道病变中的诊断效能：系统评价与比较分析
items.title_en: Diagnostic Performance of Magnetic Resonance Cholangiopancreatography, Endoscopic Ultrasound, Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangiopancreatography, and Computed Tomography in Biliary Tract Pathologies: A Systematic Review and Comparative Analysis
items.abstract_cn: 摘要 胆道疾病的诊断具有挑战性，因其解剖结构复杂且易出现并发症。目前有多种影像学检查手段可用于检测胆总管结石、狭窄及恶性肿瘤，各有不同的优势和局限性。本系统评价旨在全面评估并比较磁共振胰胆管成像（MRCP）、内镜逆行胰胆管造影（ERCP）、计算机断层扫描（CT）和超声内镜（EUS）在胆道疾病评估中的诊断效能、临床意义及安全性。共筛选并回顾了30项至少比较两种影像学方法的研究。采用诊断准确性研究质量评价工具2（QUADAS-2）进行质量评估，并使用推荐分级评估、制定与评价（GRADE）框架对证据质量进行分级。在胆总管结石检测方面，MRCP的中位敏感度和特异度分别为88.5%（四分位距[IQR] 82.1%–94.8%；范围37.5%–97.4%）和95.7%（IQR 93.9%–96.0%；范围83.8%–100.0%）。EUS表现出更优的性能，中位敏感度为94.8%（IQR 90.2%–97.4%；范围80.0%–100.0%），特异度为98.5%（IQR 97.3%–100.0%；范围95.0%–100.0%）。对于胆道狭窄，MRCP、EUS、ERCP和CT的中位敏感度/特异度分别为83.3%/76.0%、67.0%/79.0%、85.0%/75.0%和72.0%/72.5%。在恶性肿瘤鉴别方面，相应数值分别为81.0%/88.9%、71.0%/78.5%、81.4%/80.7%和72.0%/72.5%。我们的分析揭示了每种影像学方法各自特定的诊断适用场景。MRCP通常作为初始影像学评估的首选，而EUS在结石检测方面具有更高的敏感度，并可在需要时获取组织样本。当需要治疗性干预或诊断复杂狭窄时，ERCP更为适宜。CT最适用于特定梗阻性和恶性胆道疾病。现有证据支持采用分层化、基于具体病情的诊断流程，而非通用性方案。
items.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Biliary tract disease is challenging to diagnose, as the anatomy is complex and complications arise. Various imaging modalities are available with differential benefits and limitations in detecting choledocholithiasis, strictures, and malignancy. This systematic review aimed to comprehensively assess and compare the diagnostic performance, clinical significance, and safety of magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography (MRCP), endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP), computed tomography (CT), and endoscopic ultrasonography (EUS) in evaluating biliary tract disease. Thirty studies that compared at least two radiological modalities were selected and reviewed. Quality assessment was performed using the Quality Assessment of Diagnostic Accuracy Studies 2, and evidence quality was graded using the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation framework. MRCP demonstrated median sensitivity and specificity of 88.5% (interquartile range [IQR] 82.1%–94.8%; range 37.5%–97.4%) and 95.7% (IQR 93.9%–96.0%; range 83.8%–100.0%), respectively, for choledocholithiasis detection. EUS exhibited superior performance with a median sensitivity of 94.8% (IQR 90.2%–97.4%; range 80.0%–100.0%) and specificity of 98.5% (IQR 97.3%–100.0%; range 95.0%–100.0%). For biliary strictures, MRCP, EUS, ERCP, and CT demonstrated median sensitivity/specificity of 83.3%/76.0%, 67.0%/79.0%, 85.0%/75.0%, and 72.0%/72.5%, respectively. Corresponding values for malignancy differentiation were 81.0%/88.9%, 71.0%/78.5%, 81.4%/80.7%, and 72.0%/72.5%, respectively. Our analysis has revealed specific diagnostic niches for each imaging modality. MRCP is generally preferred for initial imaging evaluation, whereas EUS provides higher sensitivity for stone detection and enables tissue acquisition if required. ERCP is preferred when therapeutic intervention is required and to diagnose complex strictures. CT is most appropriate for selected obstructive and malignant biliary conditions. The evidence favors a stratified, condition‐specific algorithm rather than a universal one.
items.summary_cn: 该综述比较了MRCP、EUS、ERCP和CT在胆道疾病中的诊断性能，发现EUS对胆总管结石检测的敏感性和特异性最高（中位敏感性94.8%，特异性98.5%），而MRCP更适合初始影像评估，ERCP在需要治疗干预时优先，CT适用于特定梗阻和恶性胆道疾病，支持分层、条件特异性的诊断算法。

items.title_cn: 脾动脉栓塞术：可挽救小肠静脉曲张出血生命的疗法
items.title_en: Splenic artery embolization, a therapy that can be life-saving for small bowel variceal bleeding
items.abstract_cn: 引言：小肠静脉曲张是门静脉高压的一种罕见表现，仅占静脉曲张性消化道出血的1–5%。由于其发生率低、解剖位置难以到达以及缺乏标准化的治疗策略，其诊断和管理仍具有挑战性。我们报告一例在常规治疗方案失败后，通过脾动脉栓塞成功治疗的难治性小肠静脉曲张出血病例。病例介绍：一名45岁男性，患有肝硬化、胆管癌伴骨转移、溃疡性结肠炎，并曾接受部分肝切除术，因严重下消化道出血继发失血性休克就诊。内镜评估提示出血来源为小肠，而CT血管造影显示门静脉狭窄、肠系膜上静脉血栓形成、门静脉高压以及活动性出血的小肠静脉曲张。门静脉支架置入未能控制出血，经颈静脉肝内门体分流术（TIPS）因肿瘤负荷相关的广泛肝静脉血栓形成而未能成功。随后行挽救性脾动脉栓塞术，使用两个血管塞，术后立即止血，无再出血发生。随访影像学检查确认无活动性出血。术后唯一并发症为部分脾梗死，经保守治疗处理。讨论：脾动脉栓塞通过减少脾血流量降低门静脉入肝血流，从而降低门静脉压力并减轻异位静脉曲张的负荷。尽管该技术主要用于食管胃静脉曲张及其他门静脉高压并发症，其在小肠静脉曲张出血中的应用鲜有报道。本病例强调，在TIPS技术上不可行或失败时，脾动脉栓塞是一种有效的挽救性治疗手段。结论：对于经严格筛选的不适合常规介入治疗的难治性小肠静脉曲张出血患者，脾动脉栓塞可能是一种安全、微创且挽救生命的治疗选择。多学科协作对于优化预后至关重要，未来需要进一步研究以更好地明确该技术在异位静脉曲张出血管理中的作用。
items.abstract_en: Introduction: Small bowel varices are a rare manifestation of portal hypertension, accounting for only 1–5% of variceal gastrointestinal bleeding. Their diagnosis and management remain challenging because of their uncommon occurrence, difficult anatomical accessibility, and lack of standardized treatment strategies. We report a case of refractory small bowel variceal bleeding successfully treated with splenic artery embolization after failure of conventional therapeutic options. Case presentation: A 45-year-old man with liver cirrhosis, cholangiocarcinoma with bone metastases, ulcerative colitis, and previous partial hepatectomy presented with haemorrhagic shock secondary to severe lower gastrointestinal bleeding. Endoscopic evaluation suggested a small bowel source, while computed tomography angiography demonstrated portal vein stenosis, superior mesenteric vein thrombosis, portal hypertension, and actively bleeding small bowel varices. Portal vein stenting failed to control the haemorrhage, and transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS) placement was unsuccessful because of extensive hepatic vein thrombosis related to tumour burden. Salvage splenic artery embolization was subsequently performed using two vascular plugs, resulting in immediate haemostasis without recurrent bleeding. Follow-up imaging confirmed the absence of active bleeding. The only post-procedural complication was partial splenic infarction, which was managed conservatively. Discussion: Splenic artery embolization reduces portal venous inflow by decreasing splenic blood flow, thereby lowering portal pressure and decompressing ectopic varices. Although primarily described for esophagogastric varices and other complications of portal hypertension, its use in small bowel variceal bleeding remains rarely reported. This case highlights splenic artery embolization as an effective rescue therapy when TIPS is technically impossible or unsuccessful. Conclusion: Splenic artery embolization may represent a safe, minimally invasive, and life-saving therapeutic option for refractory small bowel variceal bleeding in carefully selected patients who are not candidates for conventional interventions. Multidisciplinary collaboration is essential to optimize outcomes, and further studies are needed to better define the role of this technique in the management of ectopic variceal bleeding.
items.journal: European Journal of Case Reports in Internal Medicine
items.summary_cn: Splenic artery embolization successfully controlled refractory small bowel variceal bleeding after failure of portal vein stenting and TIPS, achieving immediate hemostasis with only conservative-managed partial splenic infarction, suggesting it as a rescue therapy for ectopic variceal bleeding when conventional interventions are not feasible.

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
